versions.changelog:
- Initial release of agent-web skill (version 0.1.0).
- Fetch any public web page and convert it to clean, LLM-ready markdown.
- Honors robots.txt and avoids paywalls, logins, and anti-bot/CAPTCHA blocks.
- Supports both a REST API and MCP server (JSON-RPC 2.0) endpoints.
- Preview tool returns the first ~600 characters of markdown for a faster/cheaper look.
- Restricted to static HTML; JavaScript rendering and other formats not yet supported.
